info.title: Aumrti HMS API
info.description:
The public API for Aumrti hospital management.

Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_…` (or `sk_test_…` for sandbox). **The tenant is taken from the key** — no endpoint accepts a hospital identifier, so a key can only ever reach its own hospital's data.

Lists are cursor-paginated, never offset: offset paging silently skips rows when the underlying set changes mid-walk, which in a live OPD is constant.

This document is generated from the gateway's route registry and cannot drift from actual behaviour. Do not edit it by hand.

ApiKeyAuth.description: An Aumrti API key issued from Settings → API Portal. Shown once at creation and not recoverable — only a SHA-256 digest is stored. If it is lost, revoke and reissue.

request_id.description: Quote this when reporting a problem.

InvalidRequest.description: The request was malformed, or a hospital rule refused it.

Unauthenticated.description: The API key is missing, malformed, revoked or expired.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the required scope, or API access is not in the hospital's plan.

NotFound.description: No such resource. A resource belonging to another hospital is indistinguishable from one that does not exist.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Check the Retry-After header.

get.summary: List patients registered at this hospital, oldest first.
get.description:
Requires the `read:patients` scope.

**Returns patient-identifiable data.** Purpose: Patient identification for partner systems the hospital has commissioned (portal, BI, referral network). Retention: for the life of the API key.

These fields are withheld unless the key also holds `read:patients`: `full_name`, `dob`, `phone`, `email`, `abha_id`.

parameters.description: Page size. Values above 100 are clamped, not rejected.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_cursor. Pass it verbatim.

parameters.name: uhid
parameters.description: Exact UHID.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Exact registered phone number.

parameters.name: created_after
parameters.description: Registered on or after this ISO 8601 date or timestamp.

parameters.name: created_before
parameters.description: Registered on or before this ISO 8601 date or timestamp.

post.summary: Register a patient. The UHID is allocated by the hospital's own numbering sequence — do not supply one.
post.description:
Requires the `write:patients` scope.

**Returns patient-identifiable data.** Purpose: Patient registration by a partner system the hospital has commissioned (kiosk, portal, referral network). Retention: for the life of the patient record.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Send a unique value per distinct request. A retry with the same key returns the original response instead of acting twice. Reusing a key with a different body is a 409.

409.description: Conflict — the record already exists, or an Idempotency-Key was reused with a different body.

get.summary: Retrieve one patient by id.
get.description:
Requires the `read:patients` scope.

**Returns patient-identifiable data.** Purpose: Retrieval of a single patient record by a partner system acting on the hospital's behalf. Retention: for the life of the API key.

These fields are withheld unless the key also holds `read:patients`: `full_name`, `dob`, `phone`, `email`, `address`, `abha_id`, `allergies`, `chronic_conditions`.

patch.summary: Update a patient's demographics. Partial update — omitted fields are unchanged.
patch.description:
Requires the `write:patients` scope.

**Returns patient-identifiable data.** Purpose: Correction of patient demographics by a partner system. Retention: for the life of the patient record.
